title: WCS Strength
author: Steven F.
desc: Strength program designed for cross country runners To combat injuries, injury prevention and overall strength.

ex.note: I do not want anyone doing barbell deadlifts unless I explicitly tell them they can do it. I want everyone here doing hexbar, dumbbells, kettle bells
10 each side. Focus on mobility, not weight
Use a barbell. if that is too difficult, you should do goblet squats with a dumbbell or kettlebell.
Either with the kettlebell or dumbbell. Be explosive. Eight reps each side.
Find a height that is somewhat difficult.
